course.title: Phase Diagrams and Transformations
course.department: Department of Materials Science and Engineering

content.value: Consider an alloy A-B in which the melting points of A and B are 400 °C and 900 C (15) respectively. Calculate the amount of phases and chemical compositions of A and B at 500 °C. Draw necessary diagram to solve the problem.

_source_title: B.Sc. Engineering 2nd Year 2nd Term Regular Examination, 2018
